title: Chris Aubeck's book 'Saucers' shows saucer shapes are rare
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Chris Aubeck's book 'Saucers' shows saucer shapes are rare, about modern era (recent book) at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's fantastic. His books are fantastic

plain: Clas Svahn, a UFO researcher who keeps a large archive of reports, praises the books of a fellow researcher, Chris Aubeck. He points to Aubeck's book called Saucers, which he says shows that the classic flying saucer shape is actually rare in the reports people make.
